text:
### Right to Data Portability  
**Customer Right:** Obtain data in portable format for transfer to another provider  
**Process:**
- Written request specifying data
- Data provided in common electronic format (CSV, JSON)
- Response within 30 days
- Applies to data provided by customer or generated through use
name: Chunk 15/36

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing customer rights to obtain personal data in portable format for transfer to another provider. Establishes the process, timeframe, and data scope for fulfilling data portability requests.
context: Obtain data in portable format for transfer to another provider
Data provided in common electronic format (CSV, JSON)
Response within 30 days
Applies to data provided by customer or generated through use

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Request Submission
raw_entities.description: Customers must submit a written request specifying the data they wish to obtain in portable format. This is the mandatory first step in the data portability process.
context: Written request specifying data

raw_entities.name: Data Provision in Common Electronic Format
raw_entities.description: The bank must provide requested data in common electronic formats such as CSV or JSON to enable portability and transfer to another provider.
context: Data provided in common electronic format (CSV, JSON)

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Response Timeframe
raw_entities.description: The bank must respond to data portability requests within 30 days of receipt. This establishes the maximum permissible response period for fulfilling customer data portability rights.
context: Response within 30 days

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Scope Definition
raw_entities.description: Data portability applies to all data provided by the customer or generated through their use of the bank's services. This defines the scope of data subject to portability requests.
context: Applies to data provided by customer or generated through use

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Right
raw_entities.description: The regulatory and operational risk associated with ensuring customers can exercise their right to obtain and transfer their personal data in portable format. Non-compliance exposes the bank to regulatory sanctions and customer disputes.
context: Obtain data in portable format for transfer to another provider
Response within 30 days

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The natural person who holds a banking relationship and possesses the right to request their personal data in portable format for transfer to another provider.
context: Customer Right: Obtain data in portable format for transfer to another provider
Applies to data provided by customer or generated through use
